baseline_models.focus_anchor: The preposition places the person inside a lived condition, while the feminine active modifier predicates acceptance of that condition itself.
baseline_models.mechanism: The life is an encompassing mode of existence whose internal quality is acceptance rather than displeasure, not merely a container holding pleasant objects.

activation_trace.role: Life as a lived condition supplies the encompassing state in which the person is located.
Acceptance opposed to displeasure supplies the lived condition's defining quality.

changed_reading.before: He simply possesses a pleasant life.
changed_reading.after: He inhabits a whole lived condition settled in acceptance rather than merely receiving pleasant things.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun can denote the means by which life is maintained, and its modifier marks those means as accepted and satisfying.
baseline_models.mechanism: Satisfaction has a material substrate: livelihood, provisions, place, and sufficiency compose the condition rather than decorating an otherwise abstract emotion.

activation_trace.role: Means of living and livelihood make the focus state materially sustaining.
The split root's acceptance sense marks the available livelihood as sufficient and welcome.

changed_reading.before: The ayah names an unspecified happiness.
changed_reading.after: The ayah names a sustaining arrangement of livelihood whose provisions and conditions answer need without displeasure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active feminine modifier grammatically belongs to the life, while a focus branch opens mutual consent as a live lexical resonance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Personification plus the reciprocal branch permits a two-sided fit: the inhabitant accepts the life and the life, as an ordered condition, receives its inhabitant without friction.

activation_trace.role: The lived condition provides one side of a possible relation with its inhabitant.
Mutual consent activates reciprocal fit, although the focus form itself is not explicitly reciprocal.

changed_reading.before: A life gives pleasure in one direction to its recipient.
changed_reading.after: The inhabitant and the allotted mode of life are in exploratory two-sided accord.

context_deltas.mechanism: A binding record is read, a sign-grounded expectation meets its reckoning, and only then does the person enter the accepted lived condition; satisfaction becomes an adjudicated outcome rather than an unexplained mood.

activation_trace.role: The lived condition is the state reached after the preceding account sequence.
Acceptance names the settled quality produced by the favorable transition.
A written fixing that entails judgment makes the result formally established.
Certainty reached from an indicator makes the speaker's expectation grounded rather than wishful.
Two counterparts coming face to face turns anticipated accounting into an actual encounter.
Counting and account supply the evaluative operation resolved before the focus state.

structural_cues: 69:19-20 immediately precede the focus: receipt and public reading of the record lead through expected encounter with the account into the third-person result at 69:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a binding record, sign-based certainty, encounter, and reckoning; I infer that their favorable resolution licenses entry into the accepted life. A live alternative is simple chronology without the stronger sense of ratification.

changed_reading.before: The accepted life is a free-standing pleasant state.
changed_reading.after: The accepted life is the settled condition ratified when expectation, record, and reckoning converge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covered garden habitat, harvestable fruit, nearness, intake, and freedom from adverse difficulty unpack the focus livelihood into a complete provisioning ecology.

activation_trace.role: Livelihood and means of living provide the focus anchor for the material system.
Acceptance marks the whole system as fitting its recipient rather than merely existing.
A garden enclosed by vegetation supplies a habitable and productive setting.
Picked fruit and the near cluster supply food already poised for use.
Nearness removes access friction between provision and recipient.
Eating converts available produce into actually enjoyed sustenance.
Drinking completes the paired bodily provisioning of the lived condition.
Ease without hardship or harmful consequence explains why the provision is satisfying.

structural_cues: 69:22-24 immediately expand the nominal focus state into place, reachable produce, and paired consumption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies habitat, access, consumption, and untroubled benefit; I infer that these are interacting components of the focus livelihood. Alternatively, they may be separate rewards listed after an otherwise abstract state.

changed_reading.before: The satisfying life is an abstract emotional condition or a stock of goods.
changed_reading.after: It is a functioning habitat in which shelter, provision, access, intake, and bodily ease all fit together.

context_deltas.mechanism: What was put forward during an elapsed span now returns as a satisfying means of life, giving the focus condition a temporal input-and-yield structure.

activation_trace.role: Livelihood is the present yield whose temporal origin the later clause exposes.
Abundant or sought approval colors the yielded livelihood as a fully welcome return.
An amount advanced supplies the model's prior contribution or deposit.
A span of time supplies the interval over which the advance precedes its result.
Elapsed and departed time closes the period in which the contribution was made.

structural_cues: The causal construction in 69:24 links present eating and drinking to what occurred in the earlier, now-departed days.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an advance, a temporal duration, and its having passed; I infer a deferred-return arrow from prior conduct to present livelihood. The live alternative is moral causation without any economic or yield-like coloring.

changed_reading.before: The satisfying life is static comfort detached from history.
changed_reading.after: The satisfying livelihood is a matured return whose inputs were placed ahead during the now-elapsed life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nearby feminine descriptors repeatedly give their nouns operative capacities: an ear contains meaning, a garden stands high, and fruit comes near; this sharpens the focus adjective as the life itself bearing acceptance and accommodating its inhabitant.

activation_trace.role: The lived condition is the grammatical bearer of the active quality.
Mutual consent gives the active quality a relational endpoint in fit with the inhabitant.
Containing meaning in the heart shows another feminine descriptor functioning as an active capacity.
Elevation makes the following habitat itself carry a spatial quality.
Nearness makes the provision actively accommodate access by the inhabitant.

structural_cues: The focus sits in a conspicuous chain of feminine active descriptors before and after it, with the immediately following habitat and fruit assigned their own operative qualities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel feminine constructions and capacities of containment, height, and nearness; I infer that the syntactic echo foregrounds subject-side agency in the focus life. A live alternative is that the parallelism is rhythmic description with no personifying force.

changed_reading.before: The life passively causes pleasure in its occupant.
changed_reading.after: The lived environment itself stands in accepting fit and actively accommodates the person within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The negative counterpart fails to mobilize food toward the vulnerable and consequently has neither intimate support nor wholesome livelihood; by reversal, the focus life is satisfaction sustained through social circulation rather than private possession alone.

activation_trace.role: Livelihood anchors the contrast in the social distribution of means of living.
Mutual consent activates a relational rather than merely private account of satisfaction.
Urging toward an act supplies the missing social mobilization of sustenance.
Feeding another makes provision a directed social act rather than private intake.
Sustenance that stabilizes residence makes the vulnerable person's need part of the livelihood system.
Intimate kinship supplies the social support explicitly absent from the counter-scene.
Provision, livelihood, and good condition expose the punitive food as a broken counterpart to the focus life.

structural_cues: 69:33-37 couples refusal of faith with refusal to urge feeding, then couples absence of a close supporter with absence of wholesome food; this reverses the positive eating scene of 69:21-24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ethical omission and the paired loss of relationship and food; I infer that reversal lets this counter-scene disclose a social condition of the satisfying livelihood. Alternatively, it may explain only the punished figure without defining the positive focus state.

changed_reading.before: The satisfying life is an individual's private abundance.
changed_reading.after: It is socially answerable sufficiency, where the movement of sustenance toward the vulnerable belongs to the very fitness of life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Total disclosure precedes entry into a covered garden and later protection, while culpable covering of truth ends in an uncovering of regret; the focus life becomes legitimate shelter after truth rather than concealment from truth.

activation_trace.role: The lived condition enclosed by the preposition provides the shelter whose legitimacy is being tested.
Acceptance marks this shelter as reconciled with disclosure rather than dependent on evasion.
Being brought out for inspection supplies the preceding condition of exposure.
Removal of hiddenness makes the exposure comprehensive.
A garden covered by trees supplies shelter immediately after the accepted life.
Placing oneself within protection confirms a positive mode of guardedness.
Stripping away a cover turns failed concealment into exposed regret.
Covering the truth supplies the culpable concealment contrasted with truthful shelter.

structural_cues: 69:18's total exposure and 69:22's covered habitat bracket the focus, while 69:48-50 later oppose protection, concealment, and uncovering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, vegetative cover, protection, culpable covering, and uncovering; I infer a distinction between shelter granted after disclosure and concealment used against truth. The live alternative is that these images remain separate domains with no shelter logic in 69:21.

changed_reading.before: Being inside a satisfying life is simply insulation from harm.
changed_reading.after: It is truthful shelter: enclosure granted after nothing remains hidden, sharply unlike concealment that blocks truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the guarantor sense belongs to a special descriptor in the non-dominant split-root inventory, not directly to the focus form. It remains anchored in the focus adjective and gains contextual support from completion and a binding record, but downstream prose should label it a lexical resonance rather than a morphological gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins livelihood to an approval adjective whose split inventory includes obedience, love, or guarantee.

activation_trace.role: Livelihood supplies the condition that could be understood as underwritten.
The special obedient, loving, or guaranteeing descriptor activates an underwritten-life resonance.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supplies an ordering agency able to sustain the condition.
A written fixing that entails judgment supplies contextual ratification for the guarantee-like reading.

changed_reading.before: The life happens to feel pleasing.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the livelihood is a completed and ratified condition whose fitness is underwritten rather than accidental.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The contrast is cross-domain and surprising because the later life-artery threat concerns a different scene. It remains validly anchored by the focus branch's explicit lived-life sense and the later branch's explicit vital-artery sense; downstream prose should present it as a sharpened distinction, not claim that the later threat lexically defines the focus noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun denotes life as a lived condition, whose acceptance exceeds bare biological continuation.

activation_trace.role: Life as a lived condition supplies the qualitative side of the contrast.
Acceptance shows that the focus concerns the quality of living, not continuity alone.
Severance supplies the threatened termination of bodily continuity.
The artery of life supplies the biological substrate against which lived quality becomes distinct.

changed_reading.before: The reward is simply continued life or survival.
changed_reading.after: The focus distinguishes a qualitatively accepted mode of living from the mere intactness of life's bodily conduit.

strongest_changes: The preceding record and account turn satisfaction into a ratified post-reckoning condition.
The following garden, near fruit, eating, drinking, and ease turn life into a functioning provisioning ecology.
The anti-scene of withheld food and lost companionship makes satisfying livelihood socially relational rather than privately consumptive.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's active adjective allowed context to shift the reading from pleasure received by a person to fit carried by an entire lived system: adjudicated, provisioned, temporally yielded, spatially accommodating, and socially answerable.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which the active adjective genuinely personifies the life, rather than idiomatically describing it as pleasing, remains open.
Reciprocity and guarantee are branch-backed but form-distant and should not be promoted to direct glosses.
The deferred-return, social-circulation, and truthful-shelter mechanisms may be contextual contrasts rather than intrinsic semantic components of the focus phrase.
